verses.original: Παρακαλῶ οὖν πρῶτον πάντων ποιεῖσθαι δεήσεις προσευχάς ἐντεύξεις εὐχαριστίας ὑπὲρ πάντων ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: Parakalō oun prōton pantōn poieisthai deēseis proseuchas enteuxeis eucharistias hyper pantōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: First of all then I urge that petitions prayers intercessions and thanksgiving be offered for everyone . . .
verses.literalPt: ADMOESTO-TE, pois, antes de tudo, que se façam deprecações, orações, intercessões, e ações de graças, por todos os homens;

verses.original: ὑπὲρ βασιλέων καὶ πάντων τῶν ἐν ὑπεροχῇ ὄντων ἵνα ἤρεμον καὶ ἡσύχιον βίον διάγωμεν ἐν πάσῃ εὐσεβείᾳ καὶ σεμνότητι
verses.transliteration: hyper basileōn kai pantōn tōn en hyperochē ontōn hina ēremon kai hēsychion bion diagōmen en pasē eusebeia kai semnotēti
verses.literal: for kings and all those . . . in authority so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity
verses.literalPt: Pelos reis, e por todos os que estão em eminência, para que tenhamos uma vida quieta e sossegada, em toda a piedade e honestidade;

verses.original: τοῦτο καλὸν καὶ ἀπόδεκτον ἐνώπιον τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: touto kalon kai apodekton enōpion tou Sōtēros hēmōn Theou
verses.literal: This is good and pleasing in the sight of God our Savior
verses.literalPt: Porque isto é bom e agradável diante de Deus nosso Salvador,

verses.original: ὃς πάντας ἀνθρώπους θέλει σωθῆναι καὶ εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας ἐλθεῖν
verses.transliteration: hos pantas anthrōpous thelei sōthēnai kai eis epignōsin alētheias elthein
verses.literal: who wants everyone . . . to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth
verses.literalPt: Que quer que todos os homens se salvem, e venham ao conhecimento da verdade.

verses.original: Εἷς γὰρ Θεός εἷς καὶ μεσίτης Θεοῦ καὶ ἀνθρώπων ἄνθρωπος Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς
verses.transliteration: Heis gar Theos heis kai mesitēs Theou kai anthrōpōn anthrōpos Christos Iēsous
verses.literal: For there is one God and there is one mediator between God and men the man Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Porque há um só Deus, e um só Mediador entre Deus e os homens, Jesus Cristo homem.

verses.original: ὁ δοὺς ἑαυτὸν ἀντίλυτρον ὑπὲρ πάντων τὸ μαρτύριον καιροῖς ἰδίοις
verses.transliteration: ho dous heauton antilytron hyper pantōn to martyrion kairois idiois
verses.literal: who gave Himself as a ransom for all the testimony that was given at just the right time
verses.literalPt: O qual se deu a si mesmo em preço de redenção por todos, para servir de testemunho a seu tempo.

verses.original: εἰς ὃ ἐτέθην ἐγὼ κῆρυξ καὶ ἀπόστολος ἀλήθειαν λέγω οὐ ψεύδομαι διδάσκαλος ἐθνῶν ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: eis ho etethēn egō kēryx kai apostolos alētheian legō ou pseudomai didaskalos ethnōn en pistei kai alētheia
verses.literal: For this reason I was appointed as a preacher an apostle and a faithful and true teacher of the Gentiles I am telling the truth I am not lying about anything
verses.literalPt: Para o que (digo a verdade em Cristo, não minto) fui constituído pregador, e apóstolo, e doutor dos gentios na fé e na verdade.

verses.original: Βούλομαι οὖν προσεύχεσθαι τοὺς ἄνδρας ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ἐπαίροντας ὁσίους χεῖρας χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ διαλογισμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Boulomai oun proseuchesthai tous andras en panti topō epairontas hosious cheiras chōris orgēs kai dialogismou
verses.literal: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray lifting up holy hands without anger or dissension
verses.literalPt: Quero, pois, que os homens orem em todo o lugar, levantando mãos santas, sem ira nem contenda.

verses.original: Ὡσαύτως καὶ γυναῖκας ἐν καταστολῇ κοσμίῳ μετὰ αἰδοῦς καὶ σωφροσύνης κοσμεῖν ἑαυτάς μὴ ἐν πλέγμασιν καὶ χρυσίῳ ἢ μαργαρίταις ἢ ἱματισμῷ πολυτελεῖ
verses.transliteration: Hōsautōs kai gynaikas en katastolē kosmiō meta aidous kai sōphrosynēs kosmein heautas mē en plegmasin kai chrysiō ē margaritais ē himatismō polytelei
verses.literal: Likewise I want the women to adorn themselves with respectable apparel with modesty and with self-control not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes
verses.literalPt: Que do mesmo modo as mulheres se ataviem em traje honesto, com pudor e modéstia, não com tranças, ou com ouro, ou pérolas, ou vestidos preciosos,

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὃ πρέπει γυναιξὶν ἐπαγγελλομέναις θεοσέβειαν δι’ ἔργων ἀγαθῶν
verses.transliteration: all’ ho prepei gynaixin epangellomenais theosebeian di’ ergōn agathōn
verses.literal: but with good deeds as is proper for women who profess to worship God
verses.literalPt: Mas (como convém a mulheres que fazem profissão de servir a Deus) com boas obras.

verses.original: Γυνὴ ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ μανθανέτω ἐν πάσῃ ὑποταγῇ
verses.transliteration: Gynē en hēsychia manthanetō en pasē hypotagē
verses.literal: A woman must learn in quietness and full submissiveness
verses.literalPt: A mulher aprenda em silêncio, com toda a sujeição.

verses.original: διδάσκειν δὲ γυναικὶ οὐκ ἐπιτρέπω οὐδὲ αὐθεντεῖν ἀνδρός ἀλλ’ εἶναι ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ
verses.transliteration: didaskein de gynaiki ouk epitrepō oude authentein andros all’ einai en hēsychia
verses.literal: I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man she is to remain quiet
verses.literalPt: Não permito, porém, que a mulher ensine, nem use de autoridade sobre o marido, mas que esteja em silêncio.

verses.original: Ἀδὰμ γὰρ πρῶτος ἐπλάσθη εἶτα Εὕα
verses.transliteration: Adam gar prōtos eplasthē eita Heua
verses.literal: For Adam was formed first and then Eve
verses.literalPt: Porque primeiro foi formado Adão, depois Eva.

verses.original: καὶ Ἀδὰμ οὐκ ἠπατήθη ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ἐξαπατηθεῖσα ἐν παραβάσει γέγονεν
verses.transliteration: kai Adam ouk ēpatēthē hē de gynē exapatētheisa en parabasei gegonen
verses.literal: And it was not Adam who was deceived but the woman who was deceived and fell into transgression
verses.literalPt: E Adão não foi enganado, mas a mulher, sendo enganada, caiu em transgressão.

verses.original: σωθήσεται δὲ διὰ τῆς τεκνογονίας ἐὰν μείνωσιν ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀγάπῃ καὶ ἁγιασμῷ μετὰ σωφροσύνης
verses.transliteration: sōthēsetai de dia tēs teknogonias ean meinōsin en pistei kai agapē kai hagiasmō meta sōphrosynēs
verses.literal: Women, however, will be saved through childbearing if they continue in faith love and holiness with self-control
verses.literalPt: Salvar-se-á, porém, dando à luz filhos, se permanecer com modéstia na fé, no amor e na santificação.
